output.summary: The SLA guarantees 99.9% uptime (max 0.1% downtime = 7.2 minutes/month), which is under the 60-minute monthly outage limit for US business hours. Scheduled maintenance occurs only during off-peak UTC hours on Sundays, so no US daytime outages are permitted. The remedy clause states that breaches below 99.9% trigger a 50% service credit, satisfying the requirement that SLA breaches reimburse at least 50% of the monthly fee.
key_claims: 99.9% uptime target equals 7.2 minutes of downtime per 30-day month, below the 60-minute outage limit
Scheduled maintenance is limited to 2 hours on Sundays (02:00-04:00 UTC), outside US business hours (09:00-17:00)
SLA breach below 99.9% triggers 50% service credit, meeting the >=50% reimbursement requirement
